The '''Ornfra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ornfra/Legends|Ornfra]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ornfra system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
